title: Located but Not Releasable: Silent Gate Inversion and Bounded Linear Release
abstract: arXiv:2608.11822v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A growing body of work reports that language models represent task-relevant latent structure that they fail to use. Whether such structure, once located, can be converted into behavior is a separate question that is rarely tested end to end. We submit the complete pipeline -- detect, localize, and release -- to a fully preregistered stress test on a 25.7M transformer trained on causal-evidence discrimination, where a known suppression phenomenon (latent causal structure present but behaviorally unused) has previously been documented. Every threshold, claim template, and decision-tree branch was hashed and archived before any corresponding data existed. Three findings. translated_title: 定位但不可释放：静默门控反转与有界线性释放
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11822v1 公告类型：新 摘要：越来越多的研究表明，语言模型能表征与任务相关的潜在结构，但未能使用它们。然而，这种结构一旦被定位，是否能转化为行为，是一个很少被端到端测试的独立问题。我们提交了完整的流程——检测、定位、释放——在一个25.7M参数、训练于因果证据判别任务的Transformer上进行了完全预注册的压力测试，该任务此前已记录了一种已知的抑制现象（潜在因果结构存在但行为上未使用）。每个阈值、声明模板和决策树分支都在任何相应数据存在之前被哈希并归档。三项发现：（i）定位成功：对中间层观察证据通道的干预恢复了原本受抑制世界中的目标行为（配对释放优势为$0.563$和$0.854$，97.5%置信区间排除零；最佳位点释放率为$0.889$）。（ii）门控机制在外部失效。
tldr: 该论文通过完全预注册的压力测试，证明语言模型中已定位的潜在结构可以被干预释放，但门控机制在外部条件下无法工作，揭示了“定位但不可释放”的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates through a fully preregistered stress test that localized latent structures in language models can be released via intervention, but gating fails externally, revealing a "located but not releasable" limitation.
